  select 
PERIOD,SPECIES,REFERENCE_NO,REG_TYPE, PFMA, AREAS,SUB_AREAS,
DAILY_LIMIT_PC,POSESSION_LIMIT_PC,ANNUAL_LIMIT_PC,CLOSED_YN,NON_RETENTION_YN,OPENING_CLOSURE_AREAS,MINSIZE_CM,
EFFECTIVE_DATETIME,EXPIRY_DATETIME,SUPERSEDED_DATETIME,UPDATED_DATE,CREATED_DATE,DESCRIPTION
from final
where (species like 'Chinook%' or species like 'Coho%' or species in ('Halibut', 'Lingcod'))
order by reference_no, species
